alerts_triaged.justification: Upgraded urllib3 via uv lock to mitigate decompression-bomb safeguards bypassed in parts of streaming API.
Upgraded urllib3 via uv lock to mitigate sensitive headers forwarded across origins in proxied low-level redirects.
Upgraded serialize-javascript to 7.0.5 to fix RCE via RegExp.flags and Date.prototype.toISOString.
Upgraded serialize-javascript to 7.0.5 to fix CPU exhaustion DoS via crafted array-like objects.
Upgraded GitPython to latest version via uv lock to fix path traversal.
Upgraded GitPython to latest version via uv lock to fix config_writer newline injection.
Upgraded GitPython to latest version via uv lock to fix config_writer section parameter bypass.
Upgraded idna to latest version via uv lock.
Fixed app_installation mode to call GET /installation/repositories instead of GET /user to avoid 401 crashes.
Implemented safe_summary() and updated live smoke scripts to redact raw tokens and keys before logging/persisting.
Verified that hashlib uses SHA-256 instead of MD5/SHA-1 across sdk/_models.py, key_store.py, telemetry/local.py, cli/desktop_cockpit.py.
Replaced Math.random() with crypto.getRandomValues in traceContext.js and notifications.js. Refactored querySelector string concatenations in notifications.js to avoid CSS injection.
